🔄 Computer vision

Data augmentation

In simple words

Making more training examples from the ones you have, for example by flipping, turning or shifting pictures.

Making extra training examples from the ones you already have, by changing them in ways that don't change their meaning: flipping, turning, shifting or zooming a picture, or adding a little noise. It helps a model generalise instead of memorising.

Example. If you have 20 drawings of cats, you can turn each one a little to the left and to the right and shift it up and down. Now the model has 100 cat drawings to learn from instead of 20.

Related words

  • DatasetA large, organised collection of examples used to train or test an AI model.
  • OverfittingWhen a model memorises its training examples so closely that it does badly on new data.
  • GeneralisationA model's ability to work well on new examples it has never seen, not just on its training data.
